loaded.title: Loaded models
loaded.emptyBody: Load a model from the scan results or a file path below.
loaded.remember: Remember this choice for this session
loaded.reloadBody: "{{id}}" will be unloaded and loaded again (force). Active requests on it will fail.
loaded.reloadNote: Buffer size is kept; the context window resets to the default because the server does not expose the current value.

scan.title: Scan for models
scan.tip: Recursive search for .gguf files. Parsing headers can take minutes on large model stores.
scan.defaults: Without a folder the server scans:
scan.defaultsJan: and the Jan Desktop models directory on Windows.
scan.noneBody: Try another folder, or download a quantized GGUF first.
scan.needUpgrade: This architecture may need a newer llama-cpp-python:

load.title: Load a model
load.advFull: ⚠️ {{quant}} is unquantized — roughly 2 bytes per parameter per token. On CPU this is usually much slower than a Q4–Q6 quant; consider a quantized GGUF.
load.advLow: ⚠️ {{quant}} is very aggressive — it may echo or garble output. Q4_K_M or higher is recommended.
load.progressBody: Mapping weights and warming the buffer. Large models can take a while.
load.progressNote: The server cannot cancel a load in progress — closing this dialog would not stop it.

library.title: Library
library.tip: The model folders from GET /v1/config and which loaded models live in each. Scanning a folder reveals the files on disk.
library.fetchFailed: Could not read the model folders from the server.
library.noneHere: No loaded model points at this folder yet.
library.noDelete: Deleting model files is intentionally not available in v1 — the server has no authentication, so removal stays a manual job on the host machine.
